rawOutput.title: Product Rule From Scratch
rawOutput.rationale: This is a focused conceptual learning and problem-solving plan. It begins with the meaning and structure of the product rule, using one complete example before guided attempts. Support then fades across four 15-minute sessions toward independent selection, application, and error correction. Sessions keep one main action prominent and build on the learner's existing knowledge of the power rule.

sessions.title: Understand the Product Rule
sessions.objective: Recognize when a derivative requires the product rule and explain its structure.
sessions.amountLabel: Product-rule structure and one complete polynomial example
contentTargets: Identify a function written as a product of two differentiable factors
Interpret and apply (fg)' = f'g + fg' in a worked polynomial example
completionEvidence: Explain why differentiating both factors at once is incorrect
Apply the product rule to one closely matched polynomial product

sessions.title: Build the Procedure
sessions.objective: Use a step-by-step setup to differentiate products accurately.
sessions.amountLabel: Two guided product-rule setups with power-rule derivatives
contentTargets: Label the two factors and their derivatives
Substitute all four parts into the product-rule formula
completionEvidence: Construct a correct product-rule setup for a polynomial product
Solve one guided derivative and simplify the result

sessions.title: Choose and Apply Independently
sessions.objective: Distinguish products from non-products and solve without a provided setup.
sessions.amountLabel: One rule-choice check and one independent derivative
contentTargets: Decide whether an expression requires the product rule
Differentiate and simplify a product independently
completionEvidence: Classify several expressions by whether they require the product rule
Solve one product-rule problem without setup prompts

sessions.title: Verify Independent Use
sessions.objective: Retrieve the rule, solve a fresh problem, and repair any error.
sessions.amountLabel: One fresh problem plus targeted error correction
contentTargets: Recall the product rule without cues
Check a solution for missing terms, derivative errors, and simplification errors
completionEvidence: Recall the product-rule formula and explain each term
Solve and verify one fresh product-rule derivative independently

activities.label: Say it in your words

activities.body: In one or two sentences, explain when the product rule is needed. Then compare your wording to the model.
activities.concept: An expression needs the product rule when it is the product of two differentiable factors.
activities.correctAnswer: It is needed when the expression is the product of two differentiable factors.
activities.feedback: A complete answer names the product structure and the two differentiable factors. If needed, repair by saying it is not for a single factor or a sum.

activities.label: Fix the mix-up
activities.title: Separate product from not

activities.concept: An expression needs the product rule when it is the product of two differentiable factors.
activities.correctAnswer: Only a product of two differentiable factors needs the product rule; a sum or a single factor does not.
activities.feedback: The key correction is that two terms are not enough by themselves. The expression must be a product of two differentiable factors.

activities.label: Quick recognition check
activities.title: Does this need it?
activities.body: Choose the expression that fits the rule. Then submit your answer.
activities.concept: An expression needs the product rule when it is the product of two differentiable factors.
activities.feedback: The correct choice is the one written as a product of two factors. Sums, single factors, and quotients are different forms.

context.planRationale: This is a focused conceptual learning and problem-solving plan. It begins with the meaning and structure of the product rule, using one complete example before guided attempts. Support then fades across four 15-minute sessions toward independent selection, application, and error correction. Sessions keep one main action prominent and build on the learner's existing knowledge of the power rule.

knowledgeTopics.title: Understand the Product Rule
knowledgeTopics.description: Recognize when a derivative requires the product rule and explain its structure.
subtopics: Identify a function written as a product of two differentiable factors
Interpret and apply (fg)' = f'g + fg' in a worked polynomial example

nextSessions.title: Build the Procedure
nextSessions.objective: Use a step-by-step setup to differentiate products accurately.
contentTargets: Label the two factors and their derivatives
Substitute all four parts into the product-rule formula

nextSessions.title: Choose and Apply Independently
nextSessions.objective: Distinguish products from non-products and solve without a provided setup.
contentTargets: Decide whether an expression requires the product rule
Differentiate and simplify a product independently

nextSessions.title: Verify Independent Use
nextSessions.objective: Retrieve the rule, solve a fresh problem, and repair any error.
contentTargets: Recall the product rule without cues
Check a solution for missing terms, derivative errors, and simplification errors
